title.suggested: Joe Goss Posts $500 Forfeit for Match With Tom Allen

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican, reprinting the Cincinnati Commercial, reported that Joe Goss had posted a $500 forfeit with Eph Holland at the Empire saloon for a summer fight with Tom Allen, who was expected to cover it promptly.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The St. Louis Republican, Monday Morning, May 1, 1876'; filed as the Missouri Republican per rubric. Item credited to the Cincinnati Commercial.

facts.fact: Joe Goss wrote to Cincinnati of his willingness to fight Allen, and a $500 forfeit was put up for Goss at the Empire saloon in the hands of Eph Holland
Allen was said to have fought Joe Goss to a draw in England about ten years earlier, the fight stopped by darkness, after badly worsting him

notes: Title 'rematch terms' is misleading-ish; the item reports Goss's forfeit and Allen's expected acceptance. 549 is a cropped duplicate of this same item on the same page.
